needs.what: a `blocked_by_player` (player spec / binding) option on the `unblockable` op, so an attacker can't be blocked this turn by creatures one named seat controls, paired with a `choose_player` whose `players` can be "each player with the most life or tied for most life" (GameState.has_most_life) -- the chosen seat may be the activator themself
